marta_support: escalated from support  Ticket#82210  BrightWave onboarding blocked: embeddings ingest 403 and SSO pending. Need CS handoff, GA decision in 72h. :rotating_light:
incbot: Ticket #82210 created. Priority: high.
marta_support: repro: curl to /v1/embeddings returns {"error":403, "msg":"quota_enforced"}. last success 1805549800. debug token tx_BW77 attached.
diane_cs: on it. Quick ack to customer then schedule enablement call. Can ops propose a non-invasive mitigation to avoid full re-upload?
colin_ops: yes  we can enable prefix caching and route to m-lite momentarily. CLI: redwood-cli tenant patch brightwave-01 --prefix-cache=on --route=m-lite. I'll hold until ack posted.
diane_cs: drafting ack: "Thanks BrightWave — we're investigating. Proposed enablement call today 17:00 PST; temporary fallback will be enabled to resume ingestion without full re-upload. ETA unblock ~90m." send?
marta_support: customer confirmed 17:00 PST. Please apply fallback after ack.
colin_ops: applying fallback now.
incbot: Ticket #82210 updated: fallback applied at 1805550065.
colin_ops: metrics look good  ingestion rate back to normal, 403s dropped. :rocket:
diane_cs: I'll run enablement and follow-up. Renewal risk: medium until stable for 48h; mark for post-call review.
marta_support: logs and SAML trace attached to ticket. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
